Bench: Pradeep Kumar Singh Baghel, Piyush Agrawal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 7416 of 2018
Petitioner :- Chetan Malik And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Siddharth Khare Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pradeep Kumar Singh Baghel,J.
Hon'ble Piyush Agrawal,J.
The petitioners run a restaurant in the name and style the Courtyard Cafe and Lounge situated at Sector 126, Raipur Village, Sabzi Mandi, Noida, Gautam Budh Nagar.
It is stated that the said restaurant is registered under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and a copy of the certificate is on the record.

The petitioner is aggrieved by a notice issued by the Sub Inspector,
Police Station Expressway, Gautam Budh Nagar, U.P., whereby the petitioners have been asked to stop Hukka Bar.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents have no authority under the law to restrain the petitioners to run Hukka lounge.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on a judgment of the Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No. 10836 of 2014 (Narinder S. Chadha and others v. Municipal Corporation of Greater Chetan Malik And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197536745/
1 Mumbai and others).
Our attention has been drawn to an order passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Writ-C No.
7410 of 2018 (Ramesh Verma and another v. State of U.P. and others) dated 10th April, 2018,
wherein similar notice issued by the Sub-Inspector, Police Station Expressway, G.B. Nagar was challenged.

Narinder S. Chadha and others v. Municipal Corporation of Greater Chetan Malik And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197536745/
1 Mumbai and others)

sentences.text:
In the said writ petition this Court has passed the following order:
"This petition for writ is preferred to challenge the notice dated Nil said to be issued by respondent no.3 Sub-Inspector, Thana Expressway, Noida, Gautam Budh Nagar.

Under the notice impugned, the Sub-Inspector, Thana Expressway has instructed the petitioners not to continue with "Hukka Bar" which as per him is an illegal activity and further that in the event of failure to close the activities, he shall be left with no option but to seize and seal the Hukka Bar.

The submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that running of Hukka Bar is a valid activity as "The Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003" no where restrict such activity or treat that as an offence.

entities.text: Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: To substantiate the contention, reliance is placed upon a decision of Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No.10836 of 2014, Narinder S. Chadha and others Vs. Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and others decided on 8th December, 2014.

entities.text: Narinder S. Chadha and others Vs. Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having considered all facts of the case, specially looking to the averments contained in the counter affidavit with regard to several activities which are said to be illegal at the Hukka Bar, we do not find any just reason to interfere in the matter while invoking powers under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

However, looking to the allegation that the notice amounts to restriction of free business, we deem it appropriate to direct the District Magistrate, Gautam Budh Nagar to look into the entire matter and decide the issue agitated by the petitioners, if they submit a detailed representation to him within a period of 10 days from today with all necessary documents.
The District Magistrate, Gautam Budh Nagar shall consider and decide the representation submitted by the petitioners within a period of one week subsequent thereto.
The writ petition stands disposed of."
Heard Sri Kavish Suhail, learned counsel for the petitioners, and learned Standing Counsel.
Learned counsel for the parties are agreed that this writ petition may also be disposed of in the same terms.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of by issuing a direction upon the District Magistrate,
Gautam Budh Nagar to consider the cause of the petitioners and pass the appropriate order in accordance with law expeditiously.
The petitioners are permitted to file a fresh representation along with a certified copy of this order within two weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Needless to say that we have not expressed our view on the merits of the case.
The District Magistrate shall pass the order independently and in accordance with law.
